packageRules.description: ADR 0009 pins these three as one decision, and the pin is load-bearing: Next 16.3.x on @opennextjs/cloudflare 1.20.2 answers 500 with Cloudflare Error 1101 on every unknown URL, because the 404 is the one page rendered at request time. A minor bump auto-merged straight past that once. Raise them by hand, together, and only once the adapter supports the Next being raised to.

Patched through pnpm patchedDependencies, which is keyed by bare name with no version, so a bump that still applies cleanly but no longer patches what the diff was written against is silent. A human reads the upstream diff.

A docs-only dependency bump must not read as an app change. Attribution is by path, so semantic-release already books it against apps/docs, and the commit type keeps the pull request title saying the same thing. Only the type changes; the automerge rules above still apply.
